title: Research: one dirty role does not lower S3 longest Coxeter double minimum (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Answers the three-register open question of [`research/bit-s3-two-target-census-seed36501`](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/main/research/bit-s3-two-target-census-seed36501): does a third arbitrary dirty register permit a shared-call saving for a fixed S3 target triple such as `diag([xyx],[xyx],1)`?

**No**, for this fixed longest Coxeter double. On `M₃(F₂[S₃])` with paid labels `{x,y}` (transpositions), all **28** rank-one idempotents of `M₃(F₂)` (**56** factors), and target `diag([xyx],[xyx],[e])`:

- The direct six-call word (geodesic `xyx` on role 0 with `E₀₀`, then on role 1 with `E₁₁`) attains the target with dirty restore to `[e]`.
- Exact involution BFS MITM: identity/target balls through radius 3 have layers `[1, 56, 1750, 45396]`; both `ball(I,2)∩ball(T,3)` and `ball(I,3)∩ball(T,2)` are empty → no paid word of length ≤5.
- Therefore the paid-call minimum remains exactly **6**; one restored dirty scalar does not lower it.

**No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`. Does not claim a fourth dirty role, other S3 triples, or a BIT supplier.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/s3-three-role-xyx/`
- Tip: `b42f2a25ed4b33dfc7bd36fd70752f5afe702f90`
- Base: `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`
- Scope: **refined** — three-role S3 dirty census for this fixed target

Closest prior: `bit-s3-two-target-census-seed36501` (two-register S3; three-role OQ answered here). Soft overlap ≈0.15–0.25 vs that census; ≈0.23–0.48 vs just-open [#4083](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4083) (different group/engines: S3 BFS balls vs SL2(F3) pair-table MITM — not a near-literal retarget).

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/s3-three-role-xyx/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/s3-three-role-xyx/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/s3-three-role-xyx/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/s3-three-role-xyx/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/s3-three-role-xyx
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_S3_THREE_ROLE_XYX roles=3 calls=56 idempotents=28 target_minimum=6 layers_i=[1, 56, 1750, 45396] hits_i2_t3=0 hits_i3_t2=0 dirty_lowers=false short_witness=none no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_S3_THREE_ROLE_XYX roles=3 calls=56 target_minimum=6 layers_i=[1, 56, 1750, 45396] hits=0 dirty_lowers=false no_new_kappa
PASS_S3_THREE_ROLE_XYX_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=7
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/s3-three-role-xyx outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Open next questions / limitations

1. Does a fourth restored dirty scalar role lower the six-call minimum for this same S3 longest Coxeter double target?
2. Is there a priced native address-operation realization of this S3 transposition alphabet inside an admitted BIT supplier?
